description: Compares the modeled balances of a savings account and of an investment after 1 to 50 years, from the same starting amount and the same monthly contribution, the way SmartFin's savings vs investing calculator does. You give the savings rate and the investment return; each is held the same every year. Optional: a yearly increase in the monthly contribution (or one that follows inflation), a yearly fee on investments, and tax on savings interest or investment gains. Returns both modeled balances, money put in, interest, growth, fees and taxes, the difference, the same figures in today's money, the investment return at which both end the same (when a fee or tax is given), and a fixed falling-returns case at −2% a year. Use for questions like "how do 10,000 in savings at 4% and the same amount invested at 7% compare after 20 years" or "how far apart do saving and investing end after 20 years". It reports two modeled balances and does not say which option to choose. Do not use it for historical stock or index returns (use smartfin_compare_investment_strategies) or for account types and their tax rules, which it does not model. Amounts can be in any one currency; none is converted.

contribution_step_up_pct.description: Yearly increase in the monthly contribution, % a year. Year 1 is the amount given; each later year rises by this. Ignored when step_up_matches_inflation is true. Default 0

currency.description: Currency for the amounts in the summary and the link. Default USD; amounts are never converted

inflation_pct.description: Inflation, % a year. Used to show balances in today's money, and to set the yearly increase when step_up_matches_inflation is true. Default 3

investment_fee_pct.description: Yearly fee on investments, % a year, subtracted from the return (6% with a 1% fee grows at 5%). Default 0

investment_gains_tax_pct.description: Tax on investment gains, % of the gains, taken once as if the investments were sold at the end of the years. A simplified assumption, not tax advice. Default 0

investment_return_pct.description: Investment return before any fee, % a year; may be negative. Held the same every year. Default 6

monthly_contribution.description: Amount added to both paths at the end of every month, in the same currency. Default 500

savings_interest_tax_pct.description: Tax on savings interest, % of the interest, taken as the interest is credited. A simplified assumption, not tax advice. Default 0

savings_rate_pct.description: Savings account rate, % a year, with compounding included (APY in the US, AER in the UK). Held the same every year. Default 3

starting_amount.description: Amount in the account at the start, in the currency chosen below; the same for both paths. Default 10000

step_up_matches_inflation.description: True: each later year's monthly contribution changes by inflation_pct instead of contribution_step_up_pct. Default false

years.description: Years to compare, 1 to 50. A decimal is rounded to the nearest whole year. Default 10
